title: Stage B National Assembly Boundary GeoJSON Deep Validation

telanganaAssembly.defectRationale: Statutory seat 119 has 2 distinct polygon features in raw shapefile instead of a consolidated MultiPolygon. Overwriting or arbitrary polygon deletion is prohibited without official CEO Telangana gazette reconciliation.

candidateAudit.rejectionReason: Fails Rule IV-001 authoritative source requirements. Unofficial community scrapes without Survey of India / ECI digital signatures cannot be silently promoted to official data/geo assets.
